The '''Palladane family''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] family from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world of [[Chelloa]] in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. [[Gorlan Palladane]] was a former [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who had gone underground during the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] occupation by the [[Chagras Hegemony]] and its successor state the [[Daimanate]], ruled by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]]. His wife was [[Roah Palladane]] and they both had two children. Their eldest daughter was [[Aneese Palladane]] while their youngest son was [[Jalen Palladane]].
